test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**is**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject "**emotional content**" is singular, so it requires a singular verb.
 
• The correct verb form in present tense for a singular subject is "**is**".
 
• The sentence is describing a general truth about opera, so the **simple present tense** is appropriate.
 
• Other options like "**were**" (past tense), "**are**" (plural), and "**are being**" (present continuous passive) are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *Opera refers to a dramatic art form, originating in Europe, in which the emotional content **is**__ conveyed to the audience...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Were**: Past tense, does not match the present context.
 
• **Are**: Present tense but plural, incorrect for the singular subject "content".
 
• **Are being**: Present continuous passive, implies ongoing action, which doesn't fit the general truth being stated.
